grouping.overlap: Groups may overlap; near-event groups union their frame neighborhoods.
grouping.near_events: GT_proxy events; original-frame +/- radius within the same contiguous track segment.
grouping.GT_stable_inframe_pair_endpoints: Current endpoint of an adjacent GT-inframe pair with GT displacement <= stable_threshold.
grouping.history_available: Past-state existence only; not a GT validity label.
grouping.correspondence: Only available-history rows; GT distance only on GT-inframe rows; not target-identity matching accuracy.
grouping.correlations: Pearson associations of cached outputs; constant/insufficient values yield null, not causal mechanism evidence.
grouping.label_usage: GT and future-side event neighborhoods are offline scoring groups only; no prediction is recomputed.

next_decision: Separate coordinate/state contributions and inspect history controls before choosing a training adjustment.
